name: sol-consult
description: Run deep GPT-5.6 Sol/High consultations in a per-repository ChatGPT Project through the official Codex built-in browser, while preserving Codex ownership and native Sol Advisor escalation.

interface.shortDescription: Ask a dedicated ChatGPT Project for a second deep reasoning pass.
interface.longDescription: Sol Consult adds one optional advisory lane to the AI Workflow Template. It frames a single decision, selects a bounded non-secret evidence set, drives the official Codex built-in browser to your per-repository ChatGPT Project, confirms the intended model and reasoning mode, uploads the evidence, and returns the completed answer to Codex. It is advisory only: it holds no readiness, review, or closure authority, and the Codex owner verifies every material repository claim against the live tree before acting.
defaultPrompt: Consult Sol on this design trade-off
